chunks: Say: 'Let him whom Allah extends [in life] be extended until they see what they are promised, either the punishment or the Hour; then they will know who is worse in position and weaker in soldiers.'

key_terms.الرَّحْمَانُ: The Merciful (specifically referring to Allah's attribute of granting respite)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Rahman extends the life of those who are astray' in Surah Maryam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *mad* (extension) as a divine grace period for the misguided, allowing them to fully experience the consequences of their deviation before the final reckoning. It underscores the ultimate realization on the Day of Resurrection that true power and superior position belong solely to Allah, contrasting the fleeting strength of the disbelievers with the eternal authority of the Almighty.
